cohort_selection: First N lexicographically sorted case IDs, or all 147 if no limit
throughput_definition: Full nnUNetv2_predict process from launch through exit after saved masks, including Python startup, model loading, preprocessing, prediction and mask export. Output verification is outside the timer. Batch wall time / case count is throughput, not individual-image latency.
single_case_definition: Independent process-cold CLI timing of the first sorted case. Filesystem cache state is uncontrolled.
latency_definition: Synchronized predict_logits_from_preprocessed_data call, including transfers, state-dict loading and CPU accumulation inside that call. Model initialization, preprocessing and mask export are excluded. Warm-up cases are discarded, then included in every measured repeat.
parent_memory_definition: resource.RUSAGE_SELF lifetime high-water RSS, sampled after latency, including model and preloaded/preprocessed images. Not a batch-child or accelerator peak-memory measurement.
process_tree_memory_scope: Sampled sum of RSS for the prediction subprocess and its recursive children only; excludes the benchmark parent. Shared pages can be counted more than once and short-lived peaks or children can be missed. This is not accelerator peak memory.
process_tree_memory_unavailable_reason: psutil is not installed; no parent RSS substitute
